title: Bogotá Declares BTS Honorary Guests Ahead of El Campín Shows
detail: October 1, 2026 — Bogotá Mayor Carlos Fernando Galán formalized by decree the designation of BTS as Honorary Guests of the city ahead of the Oct 2-3 El Campín concerts. Both shows are sold out with over 100,000 attendees expected in total. The city prepared transport operations, purple illumination of landmarks and tourism activities.

media.caption: Bogotá names BTS honorary guests before El Campín concerts.
